author: Unreal Engine
description:
Catch up on all the action from the State of Unreal in this recording of the full show from Unreal Fest Chicago 2026. 

At the State of Unreal this year, we shared our vision for how Unreal Engine 6 will reinvent the way we ship and operate games, released Unreal Engine 5.8, open sourced the next-generation version control system Lore, highlighted UEFN’s growing developer ecosystem, previewed improvements to the Epic Games Store, and showcased inspiring projects across the community. 

For a full roundup on all the announcements at the State of Unreal, check out our blog post: https://epic.gm/sou-news-from-the-show

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch the State of Unreal, live from Unreal Fest Chicago! Tune in for news about Epic’s developer tools and services, highlights from across the community, and a look at what's ahead.

This year is about tools and workflows developers can actually use to build great games and experiences. Expect real conversations, not massive live tech demos.

The show begins at 7 AM PT | 9 AM CT | 10 AM ET | 3 PM BST on June 17.

➡️ Explore new tools and practical workflows for creating exceptional games and interactive experiences. 

➡️Watch talented teams showcase how they’re using Epic’s developer tools and services to deliver standout work.
 
➡️Discover what’s in store for 2026 and beyond, along with the foundational technologies we’re building for you.

Find out more about Unreal Fest Chicago here: https://www.unrealengine.com/events/unreal-fest-chicago-2026
title: State of Unreal 2026 Official 4K Livestream | Unreal Fest Chicago

author: Unreal Engine
description:
With Unreal Engine 5.8, you can push performance and customization further with advanced worldbuilding and terrain creation, high-quality real-time vegetation authoring, and production-ready MegaLights.

Explore faster in-engine character, animation, and physics authoring; advances in virtual production and cinematic rendering; full-body digital human performance capture and crowds of MetaHumans; and accelerated content creation via the new MCP plugin for integrating models like Claude.

Discover more of what’s new in Unreal Engine 5.8 in our blog:
unrealengine.com/news/unreal-engine-5-8-is-now-available
